## What's new

- **Neon toolbar in NDM Style:** every toolbar icon has a neon colour of its own (bright on dark mode, deeper on light mode so it stays readable), and a hovered icon brightens with a soft glow in its colour.
- **Custom category icons:** put your own pictures in the categories pane with **View → Category icons**. A set is a folder of PNG files in NDM's category icons folder (**Open category icons folder** in the same menu); it works in Modern, Classic and NDM Style. See the [guide](https://github.com/MoeJoe37/New-Download-Manager#custom-category-icons).
- **Help → Look for new toolbars** and **Help → Look for new category icons** open the guides to making and installing them (Look for new toolbars moved here from the Toolbar menu).
